facts.claim: Messrs. George Smith and Sons initiated a monthly line of sailing ships to Bombay in 1863.
facts.quote: In 1863 Messrs. Georg^e Smith and Sons started a monthly line of sailing ships to Bombay, and sixteen of these vessels reached Bombay via the Cape in 1878.

facts.claim: The steamer John Bright made its first voyage from Gravesend to Bombay via the Cape in 58 days in 1862.
facts.quote: one of the finest of these vessels being the yoAu Bright, owned by a Pars! firm, which made her first voyage from Gravesend to Bombay viis the Cape in 58 days in 1862.

facts.claim: The rate of freight for opium by steamer was Rs. 28 per chest.
facts.quote: The rate of freight for opium by steamer was Rs. 28 per chest while by clipper it was Rs. 5, and by fast clipper Rs. 10 to Rs. i6.
